not_verified: Static pose only: mesh verified clash-free at the assembled phase, not swept kinematically through rotation
Teeth are straight tapered teeth without an involute or conjugate flank profile; backlash is generous (~2 mm at mid-cone) by design
Shafts are not keyed to the side gears; no bushings, thrust washers or separate carrier bearings modelled (carrier locates on the side-gear hub journals in the cheek bores)
No torque, load or bearing-life computation; sized for hand turning only
one_line: A hand-turned open differential demonstrator: straight bevel side gears (16T) and four spider pinions (10T) in a windowed carrier drum, spur ring gear (40T) driven by a layshaft pinion (13T) with a hand crank, hand wheel on each axle.
poses: assembled: static pose, all gears phased tooth-into-gap; saved explode definition 'apart' (ring gear -70 mm X, side gears -/+60 mm X, axles -/+140 mm X, pinions 55 mm radially, layshaft group -45 mm Z)
specs: Side gears 16T straight bevel, pitch cone half-angle 58 deg, module 3.0 at the outer cone, cone distance 28.3 mm; pinions 10T, pitch cone half-angle 32 deg (atan(10/16), 90 deg shaft angle)
Four pinions on a cross pin (r4.5, Y and Z arms), pinion bores r4.7 (0.2 mm radial clearance)
Ring gear 40T spur, pitch r40 mm, 6 bolts r2.5 into carrier cheek holes r3; input pinion 13T, pitch r13 mm; final-drive ratio 40:13 = 3.08:1
Radial clearances: axle r5.6 / side-gear bore r6 = 0.4 mm; side-gear hub r11 / cheek bore r11.4 = 0.4 mm; layshaft r4 / pedestal bore r4.4 = 0.4 mm; input pinion bore r4.2 / layshaft = 0.2 mm

Bevel teeth are tapered sector gap cuts in tip-cone revolved blanks (thickness tapers with cone distance, gap floors below the root cone); phasing by fixed instance rotations — side gears at half pitch (11.25 deg), input pinion at -6.92 deg
Base plate 190 x 110 mm; overall 222 mm across hand-wheel grips, 118 mm tall; mass 3.44 kg (steel 7850, cast iron 7200, wood 700 kg/m^3)
title: Open differential (bevel demonstrator)
